message.content: I usually wake up around seven, maybe a bit later sometimes. I make tea and toast, then feed the cat before heading out. The bus ride is pretty quiet, so I often listen to music or just think. I don’t really pay much attention to the voice unless I’m tired. It’s been like this for a while—on and off. I don’t know what it means, but it doesn’t bother me too much. I just try to keep my routine. Work is fine, I guess. I don’t have many people to talk to, but I get along with my colleague. I don’t know if it’s stress or something else, but I try not to worry about it.
